clips.asr_text: Today's topic is In a Grove.
やぶの中
森で見つかった侍の遺体をめぐる物語です。真相が簡単には見えてこない中、何を手がかりに出来事を受け止めればよいのか、考えながらお聞きください。
登場する人たちがこの出来事についてそれぞれ何を話すのかに注目してください。
前半では、捕まった盗賊が武士の弓を持っていたとわかりました。では、盗賊と妻は、森で何があったと話すのでしょうか。
On silent feet.
足音を立てずに。
constable
警官
drown
溺れる
I found him in the bushes this morning.
The woodcutter said.
I saw the couple yesterday at noon.
The traveling monk said,
He carried a sword and bow, and his wife rode beside him.
I caught the famous bandit Tajomaru near the bridge.
the constable said.
He had fallen off a horse, but still had Takehiro's bow. Find the wife and ask her what he did.
Takahiro, a kind samurai, married my daughter Masako.
the old woman said.
She is proud and only nineteen. Please find her before you send me home without news.
I killed him fairly.
Tajomaru said, The wind lifted her face covering and I wanted her. I promised him buried treasure and led him into the bushes. There I tied him to a cedar tree. She fought with her dagger.

She held my arm and begged for one of us to die. She would leave with the man who lived. I freed him for a fair sword fight. Twenty-three blows. No other man had lasted twenty. She was gone when he fell. I took his weapons and left.
I crawled towards my husband.

Masago sat at the temple. The bandit had left him tied up. I begged him to die with me. His cold eyes said I was nothing, even though I was his wife. He moved his lips while I held my dagger. Kill me, he said. So I stabbed him. I could not stand those eyes.
I later tried drowning myself, but I failed. Where can I go after that?
I heard him speaking kindly to her.

Takahiro's spirit said through a medium. She asked him to take her anywhere. Then she pointed at me. Kill that man. He pushed her away and asked if she should live or die. I nearly forgave him then, but she ran away. He cut one rope and left me. I got up beside the cedar and picked up her small dagger. She had dropped it there. I pushed it into my own chest. The bushes around me grew quiet. Someone came slowly towards me on silent feet. A hand I could not see quietly pulled the dagger from my chest.
I sank into the darkness and never came back.
